positive_global_styles: instrumental Indian acoustic underscore for a short motion-graphics film
steady 4/4 pulse, every beat clearly audible
tanpura, santoor, tabla, dholak, shaker, plucked strings
clean, airy, spacious, bright mid-range and high-range instruments
warm, premium, restrained, measured and exact, never busy

positive_local_styles: D minor, with the flat third F natural, a dark worried uneasy mood
very sparse, almost nothing playing, a lot of silence between sounds
a soft sustained tanpura drone on D
a single dry high plucked santoor note tapping softly on the beat at 128 bpm
one muted dholak stroke on the first beat of each bar
quiet and tense
the key changes to D major with F sharp on the very first beat of this section, a sudden brightening and a feeling of relief
bright plucked santoor playing a light, confident repeating pattern in eighth notes
soft tabla and dholak with a shaker keeping a steady 128 bpm pulse, the groove starts on the very first beat
warm sustained string pad
confident, light and airy, clear and measured
the same steady groove for the whole section, no build, no fills
the wood-block is gone
D major, the same groove becomes sparser and more watchful
the santoor plays fewer notes, the tabla keeps a soft pulse, the string pad holds one suspended chord
attentive and calm, a pause of attention, not sadness
building and rising in D major for the first four seconds
the plucked santoor pattern climbs higher in pitch, tabla and hand percussion get busier with small fills, the string pad swells louder, a rising filtered texture
then for the final two seconds the fullest, warmest and strongest moment of the piece, santoor melody at its highest with strings and pad together, a satisfying resolved arrival
confident but restrained
one clean soft drum hit with a delicate bell shimmer exactly on the first beat
then a gentle settle, a held warm D major chord on santoor and strings fading to near silence
no percussion after the hit
decaying slowly
